source_evidence: an inability of investors to sell their ARS until there was a successful auction
question: Misconception: If an auction for an auction rate security fails, I can still sell it right away at the next scheduled auction date.
answer: A failed auction can leave investors unable to sell their ARS until an auction succeeds. This creates liquidity risk: investors may be stuck holding a long-term investment, even though its interest rate is periodically reset.
